name: Seeed XIAO 7.5" ePaper Panel (C3, TRMNL BYOS)
description: Seeed's integrated XIAO 7.5 inch ePaper Panel (ESP32-C3) running the XIAO TRMNL firmware, so it speaks Tesserae's TRMNL BYOS endpoints; 4 greys on TRMNL firmware 1.6.0 and later, 1-bit below. Same hardware as xiao_epaper_panel_75_c3, the kind for the Tesserae-native firmware.
notes_md:
Confirmed on real hardware running the XIAO TRMNL firmware. The XIAO TRMNL firmware sends its MAC in the Id header (uppercase, colon-separated); Tesserae's BYOS layer matches case-insensitively, no extra configuration needed.

TRMNL firmware 1.6.0 and later decodes a 2-bit greyscale PNG and paints 4 shades on this panel; earlier builds cannot decode one. The firmware sends its version in the `FW-Version` header on every poll, so a device on this kind moves to `trmnl_png_gray4` by itself once it reports 1.6.0 or later, and back to the 1-bit `trmnl_png` if it reports an older build. A renderer picked on the device card stays put. The panel reports `gray_4` while on the grey renderer and `mono` on the 1-bit one. A unit that provisioned itself by MAC lands on the bare `trmnl_client` kind, which offers `trmnl_png_gray4` as a device-card pick but does not follow the firmware version, so the switch is automatic only for an instance created on this kind. The 2-bit path is UNVERIFIED ON HARDWARE on this unit.
